# Arctor Labs

> Arctor Labs is a small software research outfit building and operating
> internal development tooling and security research infrastructure on
> systems it owns. Internal use only; no consumer-facing services.

## Contact
- Email: k@kimibebop.com (PGP: key discoverable via WKD at this domain)
- Site: https://kimibebop.com

## Focus
- Isolation and containment (microVMs, sandboxes, least-privilege policy)
- Developer tooling with verifiable supply chains and audit-first automation
- Defensive security of our own infrastructure

Security reports welcome; see /.well-known/security.txt.
